content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and operations software and integration services to telecom and media operators, not calling services to end customers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Operates wireless and rural broadband networks and sells mobile and home internet plans, unlike Covista's voice calling plans."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Cloud fax, email marketing and document delivery software; shares small-business customers but not the voice calling business."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Sells hosted cloud phone service to businesses, matching Covista's VoIP phone offering, though it also adds web hosting."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Billing, customer care and payment software and outsourcing for operators; a back-office software business, not voice service."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Rural incumbent providing broadband, video and voice over its own fiber and copper network, a facilities-based connectivity business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells session border controllers and communications hardware and software to carriers, a equipment and software vendor rather than a calling service provider."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Sells cloud business phone service as subscriptions, the same VoIP calling product Covista sells, though broader in collaboration tools."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Regional fiber internet, video and telephone provider over its own network, a residential and business connectivity operator."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Wireless carrier and rural wireline broadband operator selling devices and connectivity, owning cell sites and fiber networks."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers and sells rural broadband, an infrastructure owner rather than a voice service provider."}]}
